3.2 — Non-Operating Hour Spike Analysis (all sites)

Spike Summary by Site

Each site's per-hour-slot baseline is its own May average for that exact hour (e.g. the average 0200–0300 across the month). A spike = a non-operating hour exceeding 150% of that slot average (>50% above). Click a site row to expand its individual spike hours. Sites with no spike are omitted.

3.3 — SOP Compliance Score

Standby SOP Compliance by Site

Every site starts at 100. Each non-operating-hour spike (>50% above its slot average, from 3.2) deducts 1 point. All 30 sites are listed with the lowest compliance on top; breaching sites are highlighted.
